help_log_q: How do I log food quickly?
help_log_a1: On Log, search: your recent foods come first, and a few letters are enough (“sutas” finds “Sütaş”). Pick the food, set the amount and the meal, then Save.
help_log_a2: You can also type a whole sentence (“kahvaltıda iki dilim ekmek”), say it with Speak, or scan a nutrition label.

help_quick_a1: A number of calories without a food, for something you only know the calories of. Its protein, carbs and fat stay unknown, and are never counted as zero.
help_bulk_q: How do I move, copy or delete several entries?
help_bulk_a1: Hold an entry until it lifts. Let go to select it, then tap others; or keep moving to drag it to another meal. A meal’s ⋯ menu does the same without gestures.

help_budget_q: How is my daily budget worked out?
help_budget_a1: From what your body uses on an inactive day, plus the activity you add, minus the deficit for your goal:
help_budget_a2: Budget = base burn (BMR × about 1,2) + activity − deficit
help_budget_a3: BMR uses Mifflin–St Jeor, or Katch–McArdle when you give your body fat. The deficit follows the weekly loss you chose: about 7700 kcal per kilo, and never more than 1 kg or 1 % of your weight a week, whichever is less. The budget never drops below the minimum in Profile and goals. With your own target, the budget is the number you set. Past days keep the budget they had.
help_budget_k: budget calories kalori bütçe deficit bmr target hedef
help_activity_a1: Yes, by default: activity you add on Today raises that day’s budget by what it burned above an inactive day. You can turn that off in Profile and goals. Activity imported from LoseIt is kept but not counted, because what it includes isn’t known.
help_smoothed_a1: Your weight with the day-to-day swings from water, salt and food evened out. Each weigh-in nudges it, and it follows your pace, so it doesn’t lag behind while you’re losing steadily.
help_smoothed_a2: In tests on simulated histories it was usually about 0,3 kg from the true weight, closer than a single weigh-in (about 0,5 kg). Switch between Latest weigh-in and Smoothed above the weight on Progress.
help_smoothed_k: trend smoothed weight kilo trend ortalama
help_weight_up_q: Why did my weight go up when I’m losing?
help_weight_up_a1: A single weigh-in can move a kilo or more with water and salt. Look at Smoothed on Progress for the direction.
help_complete_a1: It tells obur you logged everything that day. Only complete days count as under budget in the calendar, in averages and in streaks, so a half-logged day never looks like a success.
help_averages_q: Why are some averages based on fewer days?
help_averages_a1: Averages use only days marked complete, and a nutrient only on days where every entry states it. Each average says how many days it’s based on.
help_rings_q: What do the rings in the Journal mean?
help_rings_a1: A day’s ring fills up as you eat, against that day’s budget.
help_rings_k: rings colours colors green red grey calendar halka renk yeşil kırmızı takvim
help_ring_under: Green: marked complete and within budget. It always keeps a small gap.
help_ring_incomplete: Grey: food logged, but the day isn’t marked complete.
help_journal_a1: The month’s calendar, each day’s ring showing what you ate against that day’s budget. Tap a day to see it in the box under the calendar, and Open to go to it. Below that are the month’s highlights: a line for each week (calories a day and how far under or over budget, over complete days only, and the change in weight), then what stood out, such as achievements, a new lowest weight and budget changes.
help_journal_k: journal calendar month highlights takvim günlük
help_achievements_a1: One for every 2 kg lost, up to 120 kg, counted from your first weigh-in; reaching your goal; streaks of complete days; and firsts. Each is reached once, on the first day, and a weigh-in you delete takes back what it caused.
help_achievements_a2: New ones get a short celebration; older ones, such as from imported history, are added quietly. Weight achievements need a goal weight below where you started, and are off under 18, in pregnancy and while breastfeeding. See them all from Progress → Achievements.

help_reminders_a1: At the time you set, within the hour, once a day, and only if that thing is still missing: nothing logged for the meal, no weigh-in yet, or the day not marked complete. Never in quiet hours. On iPhone, only in the app added to the Home Screen. Set them in More → Reminders.
help_private_a1: Only you. Foods you make are shared with your household by default (you can make one private); foods imported from LoseIt start private. A shared food never shows who logged it or when.
help_data_q: Where is my data, and how do I get it out?
help_data_a1: On your household’s own server, backed up every night. More → Your data downloads everything as a file you can import again.
